assessments.reasoning: Event 4f2b91d3fd674c4282dcdd8e795c3cc2, Mozilla archive, NPL 1.0 governing revision 1, [20484,20944). V.2 attaches the release test and different-terms permission to the additional products. Amendment II defines the Branded Code excluded from this product class.

challenge.method: Tested a third-party release within the period, a Netscape release in year three, and restarting the period when a Modification ships.
challenge.results: The actor and release-window requirements exclude the first two cases. The clock runs from release of the Original Code. A later Modification supplies no new starting date.

limitations: Exhibit A identifies March 31, 1998 as the release date for the described Communicator Original Code. V.1 preserves §3 obligations except to the stated extent. Product qualification requires separate facts.
reasoning: NPL 1.0 V.2 permits Netscape to include Covered Code in products other than its defined Branded Code that Netscape releases during the two years following release of the Original Code. V.2 expressly permits different terms for those additional products.
